notes.title: Druidwalker is out NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]Druidwalker is out on Steam NOW![/b] It is the next peaceful game produced and published by Coldwild Games!

Get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231060/Druidwalker/?utm_source=announcement_steam

Step into the role of a druid preparing the forest for winter. Delve into the heart of the mystical forest, explore its paths, and experience the beauty of nature. Druidwalker provides a peaceful roguelike adventure, where challenges offer opportunities for growth and reflection. Rest at the bonfire, rejuvenate, and continue your journey with renewed vigor. The game features traditional instrumental music, creating a peaceful and immersive experience. 

Watch the trailer here: youtu.be/-7Ho_vyXo80
It's a short experience, but a lot of love went into creating this one, so I hope you'll decide to give it a try! :) The game has been created by a multinational team of developers located in Latvia and published by Coldwild Games.

Hope you have a great week ahead, 
Elizabete from Coldwild Games

notes.title: The Early Access release of Stories from the Outbreak is out NOW!
notes.notes:
Attention all survivors! The Early Access release of Stories from the Outbreak is finally here!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/a5083be4e65ad4d268b45f3d08df9f6606254b04.gif[/img]

Embark on a turn-based roguelike zombie RPG with a shorter scenario that immerses players in the beginning of the zombie apocalypse. With 11 unique characters, more than 15 enemies, and three expansive maps, the gameplay is challenging, and permadeath adds to the intensity.

Form a team of survivors, traverse the area maps in search of shelter and supplies, fight zombies, and decide the fate of your crew. The game explores the apocalyptic atmosphere through pixel art and characters that speak to each other, showing polarization in views. Will different opinions prevent them from reaching their goals?

The game is available on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Join the fight for survival and make your own story in a world overrun by the undead!

Get the game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968630/Stories_from_the_Outbreak?utm_source=steamnews27march

Thank you for supporting us in our journey. Join us in [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/coldwildgames]our discord server[/url] to share your experiences, give us feedback, and connect with others survivors.

Best regards,
Elizabete and the rest of the Coldwild Games team

notes.title: Get hooked on angling and decorating in Luna's Fishing Garden
notes.notes:
Fishing is my absolute least favorite activity in any game that includes it. I say that, and yet Luna's Fishing Garden looks absolutely adorable. This super sweet angling and collecting game has an archipelago of islands to decorate, a bunch of massive animal spirits, and the style of fishing minigame I do actually enjoy in spite of myself. I may well wind up hooked, especially since it's just launched today.

Read more

Hello, anglers and gardeners!
The day has finally arrived—Luna’s Fishing Garden is here! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248212/12465e093ab0941f83cf425b332cd7d643e5dc5f.gif[/img]

Grab a rod and get ready to unwind! You’ll enjoy:

[*] Chatting with the Garden’s memorable inhabitants—just try not to insult any geckos!

[*] Cheerful, catchy, original music

[/list]

[h2]GET THE GAME HERE[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477790/Lunas_Fishing_Garden

We hope everything above brings you joy, peace, and maybe even some laughs (:
If you’d like to learn more about the game or want to hang out with devs and other Coldwild Games community members, you’re welcome to join us at: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/coldwildgames]discord server[/url].

Want to help us out? Consider spreading the word via Twitter, Reddit, etc. and leaving a review on Steam if you enjoyed the game!

If you want to support us even more, consider picking up the game + OST bundle (which is totally awesome) or the whole Coldwild Games bundle (some of the games are on sale!).

[h2]So, what's next?[/h2]

We’ll be monitoring the Steam forums, Discord, and Twitter over the next few weeks. If any bugs come up, we’ll do our best to fix them as soon as we can.

We also wanted to send a big thanks to everyone who took the time to play the demo and provide us with feedback—it really helped us make some improvements! The demo save files will not be working due to reworked quest system and a different intro, but hopefully starting the game anew will be an entirely different experience for you now.

Lastly, a special thanks to our community translators who helped us out with some missing translations in our time of need. 

Thanks for playing, and happy fishing!

Wishing you the best,
The Coldwild Games Team

notes.title: Luna's Fishing Garden - Devlog 5 - Plot and Languages
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your support so far. We've been working hard on expanding Luna's Fishing Garden plot and adding the content to the game to prepare for Q2 release. Please check out the news below:

[previewyoutube=A_X9XUVT8d0;full][/previewyoutube]

If you'd rather read the news, here goes:
[list]
[*] The game plot length has increased more than 2x compared to initial plan
[*] New writing added a lot of personality to the characters
[*] Unfortunately, that means [b]much[/b] higher translation costs that we can not afford now
[/list]

The game is currently in a playable state and we are finalizing some polishing/language data before we announce a release date.

The total game time to complete the plot, takes around 3-4 hours, if you exclude the sandbox elements. You will be able to carry on and keep decorating your garden after the game ends.

Due to the longer plot, the total amount of the words in the game has increased to more than 3 times more than first anticipated. That means that we unfortunately can not translate the game to all languages that we planned to. Based on wishlist data and translator availability, we've decided to go with 5 languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Russian
[*] Japanese
[*] Spanish
[/list]

The excluded languages are:
[list]
[*] Italian
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] French
[*] German
[/list]

I want to apologize for this profusely, but we just don't have the money to cover all of the languages that we wanted. The game has more content than planned and the quality part is getting all the attention, we just can't pay to do the extra translations currently.

I think we are going to be fine with the ones that we've decided to stick with, but if anyone is potentially interested to help with the community translations like with our last games - please contact us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/coldwildgames]discord[/url]. 

I am going to remove them from the store in order to avoid the confusion. I wish I could give better news, but that's how it is now. 

Thanks for your support and we'll see you soon.

notes.title: Luna's Fishing Garden - Devlog 4 - Graphical and plot updates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your support and feedback so far. The team has decided to move the game towards more story-focused direction. We found a writer and the game is being developed at full speed. We can't wait to bring it out to you!

Today, see our store page update and learn more about the new development plans:

[previewyoutube=FTe7GRludjk;full][/previewyoutube]

We are trying out best to make Luna's Fishing Garden a story-focused game. You'll get a chance to meet new characters, help them out and, ultimately, create the garden of your dreams.

Unfortunately, the focus on storytelling means that  we are moving away from the Sandbox perspective: while you will be able to decorate your islands the way you want to, the part where all buildings are unlocked only becomes available after you complete most of the game. And of course you will be able to keep building your garden afterwards.

The store page has been updated accordingly.

Let me know if you have any questions!

Best,
Vladimir

notes.title: Announcing Luna's Fishing Garden!
notes.notes:
Coldwild Games announces new game, Luna’s Fishing Garden!

We are happy to say that we are working on our second peaceful game, called Luna’s Fishing Garden!

Luna’s Fishing Garden is a cozy fishing and building game. Catch more than 20 types of fish, each with their own behavior, trade in the resources to Luna, and use them to build a garden of your dreams, all taking place on an imaginary Pacific archipelago. Designed to be a relaxing experience, players can play at their own pace and experience the game how they like it. 

Check out the trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KHDHKwGB_s8

Wishlist / Follow the page for more updates and notification on release!
